Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Premieres in Mumbai

Director Christopher Nolan attended a promotional event in Mumbai for his film 'The Odyssey'. He explained his reasons for bringing the tour to India, and stars like Tom Holland and Matt Damon also made appearances. The event included a premiere and a visit to a local cafe.
